message.null_remnant.stage4: The world has begun to repeat.
message.null_remnant.finale1: It has learned where you began.
message.null_remnant.finale2: The next door may not lead back.
lore.null_remnant.stage0: The first world was quiet. Too quiet to be empty.
lore.null_remnant.stage1: A shape was seen beyond the trees, then never again.
lore.null_remnant.stage2: The signs began appearing near places you had visited.
lore.null_remnant.stage3: It copies the things you build. It cannot understand why.
lore.null_remnant.stage4: It believes this world belongs to the one who returns.
message.null_remnant.nightmare_first1: A door stands somewhere in the dark.
message.null_remnant.nightmare_first2: Behind it, someone is copying your movements.
message.null_remnant.nightmare_late1: You wake up facing the wrong direction.
message.null_remnant.nightmare_late2: The door is gone. The feeling remains.
message.null_remnant.nightmare_repeat: You dream of a door in a cave.
event.null_remnant.wind_footsteps: The wind sounds like footsteps for a moment.
event.null_remnant.chunk_pause: A chunk seems to take longer than usual to settle.
event.null_remnant.distant_door: You hear a wooden door somewhere far away.
event.null_remnant.forest_steps: You hear footsteps beyond the trees.
event.null_remnant.unexplained_change: Something has changed, but you cannot find what.
event.null_remnant.fog_figure: There is a figure at the edge of the fog.
event.null_remnant.save_pause: The save takes longer than it should.
event.null_remnant.delayed_steps: You hear your own footsteps, a few seconds late.
event.null_remnant.repeated_sound: The world repeats a sound it should not know.
event.null_remnant.interior_door: You hear a door opening inside your house.
event.null_remnant.first_arrival: There is someone standing where you first arrived.
stalker.null_remnant.watched: You feel something watching from behind cover.
anomaly.null_remnant.shape: A shape disappears at the edge of your vision.
anomaly.null_remnant.appeared: You notice something that was not there.
anomaly.null_remnant.ground: The ground looks different for a moment.
memory.null_remnant.door_pattern: This door has become part of the pattern.
memory.null_remnant.door_remembers: You remember opening this. It remembers you.
memory.null_remnant.door_sound: The sound of the door lingers longer than it should.
memory.null_remnant.blocks_shape: Every block removed makes the shape clearer.
memory.null_remnant.learns_remains: It is learning what you leave behind.
memory.null_remnant.hands_build: Your hands are teaching it how to build.
memory.null_remnant.sound_twice: You hear the same sound twice.
memory.null_remnant.learns_rhythm: Something is learning the rhythm of your hands.
memory.null_remnant.world_remembers: The world remembers what you remove.
memory.null_remnant.familiar_sound: A familiar sound follows your next movement.
memory.null_remnant.returned_finale: You returned to the place it kept.
memory.null_remnant.rebuilt: Something rebuilt a piece of what you removed.
memory.null_remnant.memory_changed: It has changed what it remembers.
memory.null_remnant.memory_returned: A memory has returned to this place.
sign.null_remnant.home_learned: I know how to build a home now.
command.null_remnant.help:
NULL: The Remnant commands
/remnant lore — read the current world chapter
/remnant status — show world state (operator)
/remnant spawn — summon the Remnant safely (operator)
/remnant despawn — remove Remnant entities in this dimension (operator)
/remnant reload — reload config/null_remnant.json (operator)
command.null_remnant.reloaded: NULL Remnant config reloaded. enabled=%s, nightmares=%s, subtleAnomalies=%s, eventFrequency=%s, stalkerFrequency=%s
command.null_remnant.status: NULL Remnant | day %s | stage %s | fear %s | awareness %s | intrusion %s | active entities %s | enabled %s | nightmares %s | subtle anomalies %s | event frequency %s | stalker frequency %s

command.null_remnant.disabled: NULL Remnant is disabled in the configuration.
command.null_remnant.no_safe_spawn: Could not find a safe, loaded spawn position near you.
command.null_remnant.create_failed: Could not create the Remnant entity.
command.null_remnant.spawn_failed: The Remnant could not be added to this world.
command.null_remnant.despawned: Removed %s Remnant entities from this dimension.
command.null_remnant.despawned_one: Removed %s Remnant entity from this dimension.
command.null_remnant.despawned_many: Removed %s Remnant entities from this dimension.
